title: Chapter 226: Unable To Let Go
content:
Chapter 226: Unable To Let Go

"Uncle Zheng, I brought Xiao Luo here to make Xiao Luo return the favor."

Immediately, Xiao Yin told Xiao Zheng and others about the rescue of Xiao Luo by the Xie clan.

Suddenly, Xiao Zheng and others were shocked, and then they looked at Xiao Luo beside Xiao Yin.

"Xiao Luo, is that true?"

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo nodded, "Yes, if it weren't for her, I might not have seen you uncles."

Hearing this, Xiao Zheng and others looked at each other, then nodded and said, "Since that's the case, then you can handle it yourself, and we won't interfere."

Xiao Zheng and others took a step back.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo saluted everyone respectfully, "Xiao Luo thanked you all here."

At this moment, a voice that made Xiao Luo extremely familiar sounded from the Xie clan.

"Xiao Luo!"

Suddenly, Xiao Luo trembled all over and turned around to look.

I saw a young girl in red running towards her with tears on her face.

It is Xie Lan.

The powerful Xie clan who saved Xiao Luo's life was ordered by Xie Lan.

When Xiao Luo saw Xie Lan, he felt a little distressed, but he still showed a gentle smile, "Xie Lan, come with me, I'll take you out of here."

Hearing this, Xie Lan paused, but the head of the Xie clan not far away changed his expression and hurriedly winked Xie Lan.

"Then, what should Xie Clan do?"

Xie Lan was a little at a loss.

Hearing this, Xiao Luo still had a smile on his face, but he was a little stiff at this moment.

"You should know what the Xie tribe did to me, Xiao tribe."

Xie Lan lowered her head, not knowing how to answer.

The scene fell into a stalemate for a moment.

The Xiao clan and the Xie clan all looked at Xiao Luo and Xie Lan, with their own ulterior motives in their hearts.

But in an inconspicuous corner, the two figures seemed particularly inconsistent with the scene.

I saw Lu Xue and Ao Qing sitting on the ruins, holding snacks and melon seeds in their hands, watching the two tribes confront each other with enthusiasm, and would shout from time to time.

"My little master, do you think the Xie clan will be destroyed?"

Ao Qing asked with a fairy fruit mouthful.

Hearing this, Lu Xue kowtowed Guazi and shook her head, "I don't know, what if there is a sixth brother in Xie?"

Lao Liu, she has seen a lot.

Haven't you seen a terrifying existence hidden in the Xiao clan's ancestral land?

What if this Xie tribe has it too.

Ao Qing said oh, stopped talking, and continued to look at the two tribes, but the rest of the light was heading towards the depths of the Xie tribe from time to time, as if she was waiting for something at all times.

"Xiao Luo, I'm sorry."

At this time, Xie Lan suddenly choked up.

As the naked eye can see, Xie Lan's delicate body is trembling slightly.

Hearing this, the smile on Xiao Luo's face completely disappeared. Looking at Xie Lan for a long time, he slowly said, "Is it really worth it?"

Xie Lan shook her head.

"You are willing to share life and death with the Xiao clan. Similarly, I am willing. Sorry, Xiao Luo, I can't let go of the Xie clan and ignore it."

Not far away, the patriarch of the Xie clan suddenly calmed down and looked at all this expressionlessly.

Xie Lan's words also made Xiao Luo understand.

"I see."

Xiao Luo nodded, then turned around and walked slowly towards Xiao Yin.

"Really decided?"

Looking at Xiao Luo, who was obviously feeling a little disappointed in front of him, Xiao Yin asked.

Xiao Luo smiled bitterly and said, "I have no other way."

After experiencing this, the two tribes are already mortal enemies. Even after endless years, this hatred will be engraved in the bones of the Xiao tribe.

Unless the Xie clan is destroyed.

In the face of big troubles, Xiao Luo and Xie Lan both made their own choices.

Since then, the two have parted ways.

Perhaps, the next time we meet, the two will be enemies.

Thinking of this, Xiao Luo's tears flowed down in a daze.

Looking at Xiao Luo in front of him, Xiao Yin sighed, "Then let's go."

As soon as he finished speaking, Lu Xue and Ao Qing appeared beside him.

"You're leaving now? So fast."

I thought there was still a good show to watch, but I didn't expect it to be.

Ao Qing looked at the depths of the Xie clan with a reluctant expression. As a dragon clan, he could clearly feel that there were many treasures in it.

If you can swallow it all, you can improve it a lot.

Alas, what a pity.

"Since that's the case, then you Xie clan should be killed honestly."

At this time, Xiao Zheng stood up again and snorted coldly.

This time, neither Xiao Yin nor Xiao Luo said anything more.

But the patriarch Xie clan below snorted coldly: "Is it up to you?"

Suddenly, Xiao Zheng and others frowned.

The attitude of the patriarch of the Xie clan changed so much, and there was only one possibility, that is, the person with support.

Could it be?

Xiao Zheng and others suddenly looked solemn.

"Uncle Zheng, why not go back."

Just as Xiao Zheng and others were hesitating, Xiao Yin suddenly said.

Hearing this, Xiao Zheng and others immediately looked at Xiao Yin, "Why?"

Xiao Yin secretly sent a message, "The Xie clan has paid the price. If the Xie clan is forced into anger, we may suffer some losses. Now the Xiao clan is in trouble, and you cannot be left in the clan."

This reason is sufficient.

Xiao Zheng and others chased the Xie clan base all the way, killing many Xie clan masters.

Without tens of thousands of years, the Xie clan could hardly recover.

But Xiao Yin's next sentence was the reason why Xiao Zheng and others really gave up the idea of taking action.

"I felt a breath that made me feel palpitations deep in the Xie clan. I suspect that there is an old monster living in the Xie clan in the Immortal Emperor Realm."

As soon as these words came out, Xiao Zheng and others' expressions changed.

"real?"

Xiao Yin nodded slightly.

Xiao Zheng clenched his fists. Although he was unwilling to accept it, he still knew how terrifying that existence was.

After a moment of silence, Xiao Zheng sighed and then said coldly to the Xie tribe, "If you dare to offend me, Xiao tribe, no one can save you."

Leaving this, Xiao Zheng and others set off for Hui people.

Xiao Yin did not say much, and took Lu Xue and Xiao Luo to leave the Xie clan directly.

Inside the Xie clan.

"Clan leader, our clan suffered heavy losses. Five members of the Immortal Emperor Realm were killed,

A strong man from Xie clan appeared beside the leader of Xie clan and talked about the losses of Xie clan in detail.

The face of the patriarch of the Xie clan was also becoming increasingly ugly as visible to the naked eye.

In the end, the patriarch of the Xie clan had no choice but to sigh.

"Time is the fate."

At this moment, Xie Lan, who was sitting on the ground not far away, suddenly trembled.

The next moment, a breath of the Immortal Lord Realm suddenly surged out of Xie Lan's body.

The realm of the Immortal Lord.

After experiencing this incident, Xie Lan actually made a breakthrough.

Seeing this scene, the patriarch of the Xie clan was stunned and then suddenly burst into laughter.

"I just knew, I just knew, hahahahaha."

Xie Lan and Xiao Luo are almost the same age. Now, Xie Lan breaks through to the Immortal Lord realm before Xiao Luo, which makes him not excited.

Xiao Luo is a genius, and so is his daughter.

Now it seems that his daughter is even better than Xiao Luo.

But at this moment, he did not realize that something was wrong with Xie Lan's condition.

At this moment, an extremely old figure suddenly appeared beside Xie Lan. With one hand pressing, Xie Lan's aura was instantly suppressed.
